narrative.overview: The site feels like an open local workshop: warm, practical, and collaborative. Cream and sand provide a calm base, wine and vine give it a distinct regional identity, and a friendly illustration and agent artwork bring the subject to life. The visual language welcomes newcomers while leaving room for real technical content. Sections are spacious and easy to scan. Rounded controls and cards feel warm and approachable; shadows add only subtle ambient depth.
keyCharacteristics: Local warmth through the Rioja palette and Logroño illustration.
Clear editorial headings paired with straightforward body type.
Generous spacing, softly rounded forms, and restrained depth.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Pair Rule
rules.body: Keep body text on established high-contrast pairs; test every new pair against WCAG 2.1 AA.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Fraunces for expressive headings and Instrument Sans for practical reading and controls.

rules.name: The Ambient Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows support a real layer or visual focal point, without making every card appear lifted.

dos: Do keep the Rioja palette, two-font pairing, and rounded form language coherent across sections.
Do retain visible AAIF, Linux Foundation, and Cloud Native Rioja identities.
Do keep focus and text contrast clear on both light and dark sections.
donts: Don't use agent blue or terra for body text on light backgrounds.
Don't add heavy shadows to every card.
Don't turn community content into corporate-style claims or invented proof.
